status: SPECIFICATION ONLY. The base does not exist and must not be created until the founder approves (decision of 13 Oct 2026). Guard R14 in atlas-tools/build-art-space-register.py keeps this file identical to what the Worker writes.

token.name: plotnua-art-space-register-worker
token.why_read: the duplicate-address check (one equality filter, one field, at most one row)
never: pasting into chat or the repository

retention_is_manual: The two formula fields (erase_after, remove_after) and the two views built on them only FLAG records that are due. Nothing in Airtable, the Worker or this schema deletes anything automatically, and no automation may be added to do so. Deletion is a human act in the weekly review: delete the Hosts record, then fill deletion_honoured_at on its consent proof; 12 months later, delete that consent proof.
dates: Every date field: Date, include time, 24-hour, 'Use the same time zone (GMT) for all collaborators'.

fields.name: email_key
fields.note: lower-case email, for the duplicate check

fields.name: human_review_by
fields.note: leave blank; introductions are not authorised

fields.name: erase_after
fields.note: FLAG ONLY: this formula and its view flag records that are due; Airtable does NOT delete anything automatically. A person deletes them in the weekly review.

views.name: New this week
views.filter: submitted_at is within the past week

views.name: Notes to screen
views.purpose: strip any address, Eircode, phone number or valuables from notes

views.name: Erasure due
views.filter: erase_after is on or before today
views.purpose: flags records reaching 24 months; a person deletes them

fields.name: record_ref
fields.note: the Hosts record id as text: deliberately NOT a linked record, so the log survives the record's deletion

fields.name: email_hash
fields.note: SHA-256 of the lower-case email; never the address. Deliberately NOT linked to Hosts, so it survives the record's deletion

fields.name: withdrawn_at
fields.note: filled by hand when a withdrawal request arrives

fields.name: deletion_honoured_at
fields.note: filled by hand when the Hosts record is deleted (withdrawal or 24-month erasure)

fields.name: remove_after
fields.note: 12-month deletion-record retention (founder, 13 Oct 2026), subject to legal review. FLAG ONLY: this formula and its view flag records that are due; Airtable does NOT delete anything automatically. A person deletes them in the weekly review.

views.name: Withdrawals to action
views.filter: withdrawn_at is not empty AND deletion_honoured_at is empty

views.name: Deletion records due for removal
views.filter: remove_after is on or before today
views.purpose: flags notes 12 months after deletion; a person deletes them

relationships: None, by design. Neither the Status log nor Consent proofs links to Hosts, so deleting a Hosts record leaves the minimal proof that the deletion was honoured.
